blocks.html: Important Reminder

New Jersey law only allows cannabis deliveries to private residences and approved delivery locations. Deliveries to public places—including parks, beaches, bars, restaurants, parking lots, or other public spaces—are prohibited.

21+ only. Valid government-issued ID required upon delivery. Cannabis deliveries are available only where permitted by New Jersey law. Please consume responsibly. Keep cannabis products out of reach of children.

sections.heading: Explore Our Curated New Jersey Weed Delivery Menu

blocks.html: Lady L doesn't try to carry everything. We carry the right things. Every product on our menu is selected for quality, consistency, and value. Our team knows the brands, the growers, and the products we stock, and that knowledge shows in every recommendation we make.

Flower is our top-selling category and for good reason. We stock fresh, high-quality cannabis from trusted brands like Grown Rogue, Happy Farmer, Hamilton Farms, Rythm, Yeti, Good Greens, and Tyson. Our flower selection covers a range of effects and price points to suit every customer, whether you're brand new or know exactly what you want.

Pre-rolls offer a convenient, ready-to-go option for customers who want quality without preparation. Our vaporizer selection brings clean, discreet cannabis experiences in a format that travels well and hits consistently.
Edibles are a favorite for customers who prefer a longer-lasting, non-smokable experience. Concentrates round out our menu for those who want potency and precision.

We also carry topicals and tinctures for customers exploring cannabis wellness in more targeted ways. All products comply with New Jersey Cannabis Regulatory Commission guidelines. Pricing across our menu ranges from $10 to $150, making quality cannabis genuinely accessible at every budget.

Per New Jersey regulations, each transaction allows up to 28.35 grams of flower, up to 4 grams of concentrates, or up to 1,000 mg of THC in edibles. You can mix and match product types within a single order as long as you stay within the equivalent of one ounce of usable cannabis.

sections.heading: New Jersey Weed Delivery Areas We Serve

blocks.html: Bergen County hugs the eastern edge of New Jersey, just across the Hudson from New York City. It's one of the state's most populous counties, packed with close-knit boroughs, tree-lined streets, and communities that take real pride in where they live. From the diners of Lyndhurst to the riverside charm of Leonia, Bergen has a distinct personality in every town. Our New Jersey weed delivery reaches across the county so Bergen residents can get quality cannabis without the trip into the city.

Essex County covers an enormous range of New Jersey life. Newark anchors the county with all the energy of a major American city, while towns like Maplewood and South Orange offer a quieter, more residential pace. Bloomfield, Nutley, and Belleville sit somewhere in between — working-class communities with real character and strong local identity. Our marijuana delivery in New Jersey reaches across all of Essex County with the same speed and care we bring everywhere.

Hudson County is Lady L's home turf. It's one of the most densely populated counties in the entire country, and for good reason. The waterfront views are unbeatable, the food scene is world-class, and the people are as real as it gets. Communities here are diverse, fast-moving, and fiercely local. Our NJ cannabis delivery service was built in Hudson County, and we know these neighborhoods like a neighbor.

Union County blends suburban comfort with genuine urban energy. Towns like Cranford and Millburn have a quieter, more residential feel, while Linden, Hillside, and Roselle carry the working-class spirit that defines so much of northern New Jersey. The county sits at a crossroads between the metro hustle and the suburbs, and the people here reflect that mix. Our NJ cannabis delivery service covers Union County with reliable service and a product selection built for real life.

Passaic County stretches from the Passaic River corridor up through some of northern New Jersey's most densely populated cities. Clifton is one of the state's largest municipalities by population. Garfield and Passaic are working communities with strong identities and loyal locals. The county is diverse, affordable, and deeply rooted in the kind of neighborhood pride that Lady L was built to serve. Our New Jersey weed delivery reaches Passaic County customers with the same professionalism we bring to every delivery.
